system.description:
The Summoning skill allows the character to call spirits of the dead, demons, angels and gods to discuss matters of faith, life and philosophy, and perhaps to reach a bargain for service. This skill uses the rules found in the Summoning chapter of this book.

Obstacles: See the Summoning chapter.

FoRKs: Astrology, Folklore, Empyrealia, Demonology and appropriate wises.

Skill Type: Sorcerous. Tools: No.

Root: Perception (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 541
